request.text: How much is a new Google Pixel 9a in Obsidian with 128 GB, delivered to Saida?

message:
OutGeeked lists the Google Pixel 9a 128GB in Obsidian at $549.00, but it is currently out of stock. Its site states every item is brand-new and genuine.
The shop advertises nationwide delivery, but shipping is calculated at checkout, so I cannot confirm a delivered total to Saida.
Across the 36 shops searched, I found no available exact match. My suggestion is to wait for this configuration to return to stock rather than treat the listed price as a current purchase option.
